ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels distributed across the central lobe fields versus 35% low-intensity black pixels localized at the peripheral margins and central peduncle intersection.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous white regions occupy the medial-to-lateral expanse of both lobes. The left lobe displays a high density of low-intensity punctate mottling across the white field. The right lobe features a distinct, elongated low-intensity linear feature bisecting the white field diagonally.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 38 degrees relative to the lobe junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe trailing edge displays a consistent, moderate-frequency serration pattern. The right lobe trailing edge is characterized by a significant, high-amplitude irregular indentation (tissue deficit) located approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in sharply tapered, acute-angled lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Isolated, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters are distributed across the white fields of both lobes, particularly visible as high-contrast black spots on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of a prominent, dark linear disruption on the right lobe white field; secondary, thinner horizontal linear marks are visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch and ragged tissue disruption on the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating significant acquired trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellow-tan pixel discoloration visible on the proximal-inner portion of the right lobe's white pigmentation field.
